How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
Orders generally have a processing time of 3 to 5 business days before they are fulfilled. Once your order ships, you will receive a confirmation email with your tracking link.
Please note that it can take up to 72 hours for the tracking details to update once generated. Is there anything else I can help you with?

Once it ships, how long is delivery?
Once your order has shipped, standard domestic shipping typically takes 7 to 10 business days, or 3 to 5 business days if you qualify for standard domestic shipping on higher order values.
If you selected priority or overnight delivery at checkout, it will arrive faster once processed. Is there anything else I can help you with?

Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
Once an order is placed, it cannot be edited or modified to upgrade the shipping method.
For standard or economy shipping orders placed within contiguous US, there is a short 2-hour window after placing the order where you can self-cancel it from your Order Confirmation page and place a new order with priority or overnight shipping instead. Is there anything else I can help you with?
